#define NN 1000111
#define mod 1000000007
using namespace std;
typedef long long INT;

INT vst[NN], arr[NN];

INT power(INT u, int n) {
    INT res = 1;
    while (n) {
        if (n & 1) res = res * u % mod;
        u = u * u % mod;
        n >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    if (k == 0) { cout << power(p, p - 1) << endl; return 0; }
    if (k == 1) { cout << power(p, p) << endl; return 0; }

    for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
        if (vst[i]) continue;
        INT u = i;
        int cnt = 0;
        while (!vst[u]) {
            vst[u] = 1;
            u = u * k % p;
            ++cnt;
        }
        arr[cnt]++;
    }

    INT ans = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= p - 1; ++i) {
        if (!arr[i]) continue;
        INT tmp = power((i * arr[i] + 1) % mod, arr[i]);
        ans = ans * tmp % mod;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
